data.name: Private National Wildlife Refuge Eco Tour
data.headline: Inside the federally protected refuges around the Lower Keys
data.description:
A three-hour private eco charter through the Great White Heron and Key West National Wildlife Refuges — federally protected zones surrounding the Lower Keys and home to some of Florida’s most untouched marine habitat. Your USCG-licensed captain narrates as you go: mangrove forests, seagrass flats, bird rookeries, the occasional manatee, and the reef patches where green sea turtles graze. Best booked early morning or late afternoon when wildlife is most active.

Quick facts: 

• 3 hrs $995 
• Private (your group only) 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• Fuel + safety gear included

data.itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet at Dock A, Slip #32. After a safety briefing, we cruise toward protected backcountry waters.

Mangrove Exploration
Navigate through calm mangrove-lined channels and shallow flats. Learn about their critical role as nurseries for marine life and protection against coastal erosion.

Wildlife Observation
Slow cruising through National Wildlife Refuge waters for dolphin sightings, sea turtles, rays, shorebirds, osprey, and pelicans.

Shallow Water Stop (Conditions Permitting)
Optional stop in a quiet cove or sandbar area to explore shallow waters and observe marine life up close.

Return Cruise
Relax on the scenic ride back to the marina.

data.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – National Wildlife Refuge Eco Tour Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re excited to welcome you aboard your Private Eco Adventure Charter — a 3-hour exploration of protected backcountry waters surrounding Key West.

Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and meaningful experience.

✅ Before Your Tour

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Complete the insurance waiver: [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) and captain must complete the Bareboat Agreement together at the dock before departure, but prior to arrival, you may begin: [here](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/ez5636zbxexwrng7dtz6mq/web/)

All forms must be completed prior to arrival.

🌿 Your Eco Experience

This private 3-hour tour explores:

• Mangrove forests
• Seagrass flats
• National Wildlife Refuge waters
• Dolphin and bird habitats
• Protected shallow ecosystems

Your captain will tailor the route based on wildlife activity and environmental conditions.

Wildlife sightings are common but cannot be guaranteed.

📍 Departure Details

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

🩺 Health & Safety

This is generally a calm-water tour.

Guests should be comfortable boarding and riding on a vessel.

The captain may adjust route for safety and environmental protection.

• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

🎁 Complimentary Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools and fitness center before and after your tour.

We look forward to sharing the natural beauty of the Florida Keys with you.

Best regards,
David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter

Your safety is our highest priority.
